name: rasa.core
description:
RasaOS · Core. The singleton L1 shared foundation every domain + orchestrator Element depends on. Per canon Spec §6: 'exactly one — rasa.core (dotted name rasa.core, no .identifier suffix). The shared bones every domain and orchestrator depends on. Vocabulary, output styles, stamp definitions, common rules. First-party-only.'

v0.1.0 is the canon-shaped Phase 1 SHELL — content/ subdirs exist but are empty scaffolds. Phase 2 (separate session) will extract universal content from rasa.domain.code (vocabulary, output-styles, stamps, craft-rules, etc.) into this Element's content/, then update rasa.domain.code + rasa.domain.legal + future domain/orchestrator Elements to declare requires.elements: [rasa.core]. (task-rules was removed from this list 2026-06-18 — task management shipped as the opt-in Element rasa.module.tasks, not core content.)

Singleton per canon. The name regex (Spec §3) has an exception clause: 'OR be exactly rasa.core / rasa.kernel (the two singletons).' rasa.core has no .identifier suffix.

rasa.note: rasa.core is one of two canon singletons (rasa.core + rasa.kernel) — no .identifier suffix in the name. Per canon Spec §6 kinds table: 'Exactly one: core (dotted name rasa.core). The shared bones every domain and orchestrator depends on.' The Element structurally resembles a domain (per canon §6 kind-specific shape variation: 'core: same shape as domain/orchestrator, no requires.elements (it depends on nothing).'); v0.1.0 conforms_to declares we used the rasa.domain.core template as the structural baseline. rasa.shape_pattern='agnostic' since content/ shape is determined by what gets extracted from domain-code in Phase 2.

element.description: Files mirrored into the install target per canon ELEMENT_CONTRACT.md §7. v0.1.0 ships all as opt-in scaffold — registered for check-manifest coverage but not installed automatically. Phase 2 will populate skills/, rules/, agents/ with extracted-from-domain-code universal content, then change policies to directory-mirror.

files.note: Universal skills (Phase 2 extraction target: any skill from domain-code that's NOT engineering-specific — e.g., audit, save, handoff, stamp helpers).

Universal rules (Phase 2 extraction target: craft-rules, vocabulary.md, stamps.md from domain-code). NOTE: task-rules was removed from this list 2026-06-18 — task management shipped as the opt-in Element rasa.module.tasks, not core content.
Universal Claude subagent definitions (Phase 2 extraction target: code-reviewer, doc-scanner if generic enough — or skip if too engineering-specific).

seed.description: One-time files copied at install only. Per canon ELEMENT_CONTRACT.md §7.

files.note: Stamped with the Element HEAD commit SHA at init time. Lockfile shape per canon Spec §6.

scaffold.description: Empty directories created at init. v0.1.0 ships none — Phase 2 will populate scaffold as content extraction lands.
